name: log_volume_bounds

logrotate_stanza.rationale: The distribution stanza is edited in place to add a maxsize bound; logrotate rejects a second stanza for the same files.

logrotate_stanza_backup.rationale: The unmodified distribution stanza, preserved once before the first edit so the bound can be re-derived or reverted.

timer_drop_in.rationale: Runs logrotate hourly so maxsize is enforced within the hour.

rsyslog_rate_limit.rationale: Per-process ceiling on the system log socket.

truncation_evidence.rationale: The last megabyte of any log the safeguard truncated during an emergency reclaim, one small file per event.

storage.rationale: Linux-only host configuration verified by file content; the evidence directory holds at most one megabyte per truncation event.

description: Bound the flat-file system log store (rsyslog + logrotate) so no runaway writer can fill the disk: maxsize rotation, hourly logrotate, per-process rate limit, emergency truncation of logs already far past the bound

linux.reason: Host safeguards mutate host state and cannot ship in a desktop bundle.

macos.reason: Host safeguards mutate host state and cannot ship in a desktop bundle.

windows.reason: Host safeguards mutate host state and cannot ship in a desktop bundle.

macos.evidence: macOS bounds its unified log store and newsyslog rotates by size by default; there is no unbounded flat syslog file to protect.

windows.evidence: Windows event logs carry a maximum size and overwrite policy by default; there is no unbounded flat syslog file to protect.
